name: KromiumPermissionRequest
summary: Encapsulates an incoming media or device permission request from a web page.
declaration:
data class KromiumPermissionRequest(
    val url: String,
    val origin: String,
    val requestedTypes: Set<KromiumPermissionType>,
    val rawFlags: Int
)

constructors.signature: KromiumPermissionRequest(url: String, origin: String, requestedTypes: Set<KromiumPermissionType>, rawFlags: Int)

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Full URL of the frame initiating the permission request.

parameters.name: requestedTypes
parameters.description: The set of permission types being requested.

parameters.name: rawFlags
parameters.description: The raw Chromium media permission bitmask.

properties.name: url
properties.description: Full URL of the frame initiating the permission request.

properties.name: requestedTypes
properties.description: The set of permission types being requested.

properties.name: rawFlags
properties.description: The raw Chromium media permission bitmask.

methods.name: hasAudio
methods.description: True if the request seeks microphone access.

methods.name: hasVideo
methods.description: True if the request seeks camera / webcam video capture access.

methods.name: hasScreenShare
methods.description: True if the request seeks screen sharing / desktop video capture access.

methods.name: hasDesktopAudio
methods.description: True if the request seeks system audio capture access.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: True if the request includes the specified permission type.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: The permission type to check for.

companionMethods.name: from
companionMethods.signature: fun from(requestingUrl: String, accessFlags: Int): KromiumPermissionRequest
companionMethods.description: Constructs a KromiumPermissionRequest from a URL and raw native bitmask.
